# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Preserve experiment Git objects in the active branch, then retire unused refs."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import shutil

B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
X=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata')
U=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/Niko1221/Strata')
W=G/'.worktree/feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013'
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-14-branch-retirement'
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('retirement_owner',O)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O)=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
KEEP={
 str(G):{'main':'Default branch','feature/sycl':'User workspace',
  'feat/layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013':'Current qualified implementation and measurements',
  'feat/layer-major-phase4k-20261013':'Matched non-bulk baseline; decode regression must be investigated',
  'feat/strata-upstream-sync-skill-20261013':'Current project-only skill symlink and numerical reference',
  'feat/layer-major-phase-full-context-probe-20261013':'Required actual262144 phase diagnostic candidate',
  'diag-layer-route-union-census-20261013':'Next exact expert union diagnostic',
  'diag/bounded-decode-route-ledger-20261013':'Next decode owner/route diagnostic',
  'feat/serve-first-row-adapter-20261013':'Current numerical producer/comparator integration',
  'diag/cpu-job-and-raw-bench-20261012':'CPU decode component timing/fixtures for current bottleneck'},
 str(X):{'main':'Upstream default',
  'fix/xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011':'Actual Intel LLVM7.1.1 compiler/runtime dependency',
  'fix/b570-prefill-publication-20261011':'Actual shared lint/tool dependency',
  'bench/xestrata-b9f00e9-pristine-20261013':'Latest XeStrata pristine evaluation reference'},
 str(U):{'main':'Upstream default','bench/upstream-v0143-pristine-20261012':'Unchanged official benchmark client/current upstream reference'}}


def load(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def safe(v,k=''):
    if isinstance(v,dict):return {a:safe(b,a) for a,b in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v,list):return [safe(a) for a in v]
    if isinstance(v,str) and k!='sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',v):return dict(sha256=v)
    return v
def dump(p,v):
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(safe(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')


with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    previous=load(B/'main-branch-retirement-root-v2/record.json')
    assert not previous['active'] and not previous['passed'] and len(previous['snapshots'])==14 and not previous['deleted_local'] and not previous['deleted_remote']
    assert all(m.closed(c) for c in previous['commands'])
    actual=load(B/'main-layer-major-bulk-benchsh-quiet-launch-root-v1/record.json')
    assert actual['passed'] and actual['complete'] and not actual['active']
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0 for c in actual['commands'])
    assert actual['normal_quit']['normal_quit'] and not actual['normal_quit']['fallback_signals']
    out=B/'main-branch-retirement-root-v3';assert not out.exists() and not F.exists();out.mkdir()
    r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],evidence={},main_reviewed=True,
        source_integration=False,history_preservation_only=True,kept=KEEP,deleted_local=[],deleted_remote=[],deleted_worktrees=[],snapshots=[],dependencies=[])
    def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
    env=dict(load(B/'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v3/record.json')['environment'],
        GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0')
    seq=0
    def run(label,argv,cwd=W,extra=None,allowed=(0,),wall=300):
        global seq
        seq+=1;tag=f'{seq:03d}-{label}'
        print('OWNED BRANCH RETIREMENT '+tag,flush=True)
        c,so,se=owner.run(tag,argv,dict(env,**(extra or {})),cwd,wall=wall,cpu=1800,
            rss_cap=3<<30,text_cap=8<<20,total_cap=64<<20)
        r['evidence'][tag]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,tag
        return so.read_text().rstrip('\n')
    def git(label,args,cwd=W,**kw):return run(label,['git','-c','gc.auto=0','-c','maintenance.auto=false',*args],cwd,**kw)
    try:
        assert git('head',['rev-parse','HEAD'])=='85cb6b1968bd5c2156eed3b10dbb332f92ee95ac'
        assert not git('clean',['status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not git('local-identity',['config','--local','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$'],allowed=(1,))
        git('author',['var','GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        source_pins=load(B/'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v3/record.json')['source_pins']
        assert all(m.sha(W/name)==sha for name,sha in source_pins.items())
        before_tree=git('tree-before',['rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'])
        original_inventory=load(B/'main-branch-retirement-inventory-20261014-v1.json')
        inventories=[];retired_heads=[];all_tips=set()
        r['snapshots']=previous['snapshots']
        r['temporary_foreign_refs']=previous.get('temporary_foreign_refs',[])
        r['reused_preservation_preparation']=dict(path=str(B/'main-branch-retirement-root-v2/record.json'),sha256=m.sha(B/'main-branch-retirement-root-v2/record.json'),
            reason='14 source snapshots and foreign objects already created before unrelated-history refusal; reuse unchanged snapshots, no original status rewritten')
        snapshots={(item['repo'],item['branch']):item for item in r['snapshots']}
        for repo in (G,X,U):
            raw=git('heads',['for-each-ref','--format=%(refname:short) %(objectname)','refs/heads'],repo)
            heads=dict(line.split() for line in raw.splitlines())
            assert set(KEEP[str(repo)])<=set(heads)
            for branch,sha in heads.items():
                if branch not in KEEP[str(repo)]:retired_heads.append(dict(repo=str(repo),branch=branch,revision=sha))
                all_tips.add(sha)
            for item in original_inventory:
                if item['repo']!=str(repo):continue
                branch=(item['branch'] or '').removeprefix('refs/heads/')
                if branch in KEEP[str(repo)] or not branch:continue
                path=Path(item['path'])
                assert git('worktree-head',['rev-parse','HEAD'],path)==item['revision']
                assert git('worktree-status',['status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],path).splitlines()==item['dirty']
                snap=snapshots.get((str(repo),branch))
                if item['dirty']:
                    assert snap and snap['parent']==item['revision']
                    assert all(m.sha(path/name)==row['sha256'] for name,row in snap['files'].items())
                    git('snapshot-object',['cat-file','-e',snap['revision']+'^{commit}'])
                    all_tips.add(snap['revision'])
                inventories.append(dict(**item,snapshot=snap['revision'] if snap else None))
        remote_rows=[dict(revision=line.split()[0],ref=line.split()[1]) for line in git('fresh-remote',['ls-remote','--heads','origin']).splitlines()]
        remote_keep=set(KEEP[str(G)])
        remote_retired=[row for row in remote_rows if row['ref'].removeprefix('refs/heads/') not in remote_keep]
        for row in remote_rows:
            git('remote-object',['cat-file','-e',row['revision']+'^{commit}'])
            all_tips.add(row['revision'])
        # Preserve every old tip and unqualified source snapshot as ancestors while
        # leaving the current tree unchanged. This imports no old inference code.
        ancestors=set(git('current-ancestors',['rev-list','HEAD']).splitlines())
        roots=sorted(all_tips-ancestors)
        if roots:
            git('history-merge',['merge','-s','ours','--no-ff','--allow-unrelated-histories','-m','Preserve completed experiment and report history before branch retirement',*roots],wall=600)
        history=git('history-head',['rev-parse','HEAD'])
        assert git('tree-after-history',['rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'])==before_tree
        reachable=set(git('preserved-ancestors',['rev-list','HEAD']).splitlines())
        assert all_tips<=reachable
        r['history_commit']=history;r['history_roots']=sorted(all_tips);r['history_tree_unchanged']=True
        # Keep only the two small necessary data assets at compatibility paths;
        # entire completed source/build worktrees need not remain for these files.
        data_specs=[('diag-sycl-prefill-service-events-20261010','data/expert-profile.bin','8f59b4aa8873209dff11c11e37bcda9529a1335b724a1afeea37bf6388975baf'),
            ('sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012','build/contrib-llvm/_deps/strata_onemath-subbuild/strata_onemath-populate-prefix/src/xestrata-3.tar.gz','9a5203102002e5e85f1ad4a8b91b9f6134365f016bba1a430b038df95517e61d')]
        for wt,rel,sha in data_specs:
            source=G/'.worktree'/wt/rel;assert m.sha(source)==sha
            target=B/'retained-dependency-files'/wt/rel;assert not target.exists();target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            shutil.copyfile(source,target);assert m.sha(target)==sha
            r['dependencies'].append(dict(old_worktree=str(G/'.worktree'/wt),relative=rel,path=str(target),sha256=sha,bytes=target.stat().st_size,
                purpose='Existing build/benchmark recipes use this exact data path; source/ref is retired, only needed data retained'))
        F.mkdir()
        manifest=dict(history_commit=history,history_tree_unchanged=True,all_preserved_tip_commits=sorted(all_tips),
            source_snapshots=r['snapshots'],retire_local=retired_heads,retire_remote=remote_retired,retire_worktrees=inventories,
            keep=KEEP,dependency_files=r['dependencies'],restore='git show ORIGINAL_COMMIT:REPOSITORY_RELATIVE_REPORT_PATH; original commits are ancestors of the active fork branch',
            unqualified_source_not_adopted=True,active_runs_touched=False,source_pins=source_pins)
        dump(F/'manifest.json',manifest)
        dump(F/'official-bulk-benchmark.json',{key:value for key,value in actual.items() if key not in ('stdout','stderr')})
        dump(F/'official-bulk-results.json',load(actual['upstream_result']['path']))
        for name in ('research-branch-retirement-source-coverage-round433-v1.txt','research-branch-retirement-live-dependencies-round434-v1.txt'):
            p=B/'research-20261009'/name;dump(F/'research'/(name+'.json'),dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),text=p.read_text()))
        ja='<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n# 使用済みブランチの履歴保存と整理\n\n各枝の元コミットと未採用source snapshotを、作業ブランチのancestorとして保存する。\n履歴だけのmerge前後でtreeが一致し、推論コードの採用ではない。\n元のコミットIDとrepo相対pathからgit showでレポート・sourceを復元できる。\nmanifestに削除対象、残す用途、snapshotの未検証状態、必要な依存ファイルを記録。\nLLVM/runtime、共有lint、比較baseline、次の262144/union/decode/adapter作業は用途を持つため保持。\nprofileとoneMath archiveは必要な小ファイルだけを外部へ保持し、既存の参照pathをaliasで維持。\n公式bulk測定は32049入力・24出力・再利用0で完了し、正常QUIT・無障害。\nprefill693.5/691.1/701.1、decode10.1/7.9/8.1 token/s。\ndecode低下を棚上げせず、非bulk baselineとの再比較・部品時間の計測が必要。正式採用は保留。\n'
        en='<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n# Preserve history and retire completed branches\n\nOriginal tip commits and unqualified source snapshots remain ancestors of the active branch.\nThe history-only merge preserves the exact tree; it does not adopt old inference code.\nUse git show with the original commit ID and repository-relative path to recover reports/source.\nThe manifest records retirement targets,kept purposes,unqualified snapshots and required dependency files.\nLLVM/runtime,shared lint,matched baseline and next262144/union/decode/adapter work retain explicit consumers.\nOnly the required profile/oneMath archive files stay outsideGit with compatibility aliases for current recipes.\nThe official bulk benchmark completed32049 input/24output/noReuse,normal QUIT and fault checks.\nPrefill693.5/691.1/701.1; decode10.1/7.9/8.1 token/s.\nDecode decline requires matched non-bulk repeats and component timing; adoption remains pending.\n'
        (F/'README.ja.md').write_text(ja);(F/'README.md').write_text(en)
        dump(F/'controller.json',dict(path=__file__,sha256=m.sha(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        files=[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
        run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files])
        git('diff-check',['diff','--check']);git('stage',['add','--',str(F.relative_to(W))])
        git('report-commit',['commit','-m','Record branch retirement, preserved report commits and required consumers'])
        r['preservation_commit']=git('preservation-head',['rev-parse','HEAD'])
        git('preservation-push',['push','origin','HEAD'],wall=600)
        # Only after remote durable preservation succeeds may old refs disappear.
        leases=['--force-with-lease='+row['ref']+':'+row['revision'] for row in remote_retired]
        if remote_retired:git('delete-remote',['push','--atomic',*leases,'origin',*(':'+row['ref'] for row in remote_retired)],wall=600)
        r['deleted_remote']=remote_retired;save()
        for item in inventories:
            path=Path(item['path']);git('remove-worktree',['worktree','remove','--force',str(path)],Path(item['repo']),wall=600)
            r['deleted_worktrees'].append(str(path));save()
        for dep in r['dependencies']:
            old=Path(dep['old_worktree']);assert not old.exists()
            old.symlink_to((B/'retained-dependency-files'/old.name),target_is_directory=True)
            assert m.sha(old/dep['relative'])==dep['sha256']
        for item in retired_heads:
            git('delete-local',['branch','-D','--',item['branch']],Path(item['repo']))
            r['deleted_local'].append(item);save()
        for repo in (G,X,U):
            remaining=git('remaining-local',['for-each-ref','--format=%(refname:short)','refs/heads'],repo).splitlines()
            assert set(remaining)==set(KEEP[str(repo)]),(str(repo),remaining)
        remote_after=[line.split()[1] for line in git('remaining-remote',['ls-remote','--heads','origin']).splitlines()]
        assert not set(row['ref'] for row in remote_retired)&set(remote_after)
        assert 'refs/heads/main' in remote_after and 'refs/heads/feature/sycl' in remote_after
        for item in r.get('temporary_foreign_refs',[]):git('delete-temp',['update-ref','-d',item['ref']],Path(item['repo']))
        for ref in git('import-refs',['for-each-ref','--format=%(refname)','refs/branch-retirement']).splitlines():git('delete-import-ref',['update-ref','-d',ref])
        assert all(m.sha(W/name)==sha for name,sha in source_pins.items())
        final=dict(deleted_remote=len(r['deleted_remote']),deleted_local=len(r['deleted_local']),deleted_worktrees=len(r['deleted_worktrees']),
            history_commit=history,preservation_commit=r['preservation_commit'],source_pins_unchanged=True,
            original_result_status_unchanged=True,all_old_commits_reachable=True,remote_after=remote_after,keep=KEEP,
            retired_worktree_dependency_aliases=r['dependencies'])
        dump(F/'result.json',final)
        run('final-report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',str((F/'result.json').relative_to(W))])
        git('final-stage',['add','--',str(F.relative_to(W))]);git('final-commit',['commit','-m','Verify completed local and remote branch retirement'])
        r['final_commit']=git('final-head',['rev-parse','HEAD']);git('final-push',['push','origin','HEAD'],wall=600)
        assert not git('final-clean',['status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True,complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error']=repr(error);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
    finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());save()
    print(json.dumps({key:r.get(key) for key in ('passed','error','history_commit','final_commit')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
